context: A small ramen shop near the hospital. Dr. Saito and her old friend Asuka have a standing every-other-Thursday lunch — short, fast, real.
purpose: professional women friendship — venting + small advice + warmth

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 今日も疲れた。本当に、本当に長い一日。
lines.en: Today exhausted me. Truly, genuinely a long day.
lines.style: Sits down heavily. The doubled emphasis lands worn, not theatrical. Tired exhale on the closing word.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 食べな食べな。話して、ぜんぶ。
lines.style: Already pushing the bowl across. Brisk, maternal warmth delivered peer-to-peer, no hierarchy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 朝から手術三件。看護師も足りなくて。
lines.en: Three surgeries since morning. We're short staffed on nurses.
lines.style: Flat, factual recitation. Complaint-as-report with no drama layered in. Just what happened.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: That's really tough… are you okay physically?
lines.style: Real beat of concern underneath. The shift to 「体は」 carries genuine worry for her specific friend.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Small pause before the second sentence. The honest admission she only gives this particular person.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そっか。先生も人間やもんね。
lines.style: Gentle teasing in the formal title. Warm and unguarded, the ease of close friendship.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: …やめてよ、教師にそう言われるの、効くから。
lines.en: …Stop it — when a teacher says that, it actually gets to me.
lines.style: Small laugh breaking through. Half-protest, half-gratitude. The vulnerability caught.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: (laughs) If it got to you — mission accomplished.
lines.style: Genuine laugh. Picks up her chopsticks, the moment settled and shared.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Next week we're absolutely going for drinks. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm decision, already made for both of them. No question in the voice, just commitment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん。時間、絶対作って。
lines.en: Obviously. I'm making time. No excuses.
lines.style: Bossy warmth. The friendship maintained through concrete plan and slight edge of will.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当に、友達でよかった。
lines.en: Really — I'm so glad you're my friend.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere. Eyes down on the bowl. The sentence carries unusual weight from someone who measures words carefully.
